overview: The Owlbear Uplands are the ancestral high‑ground territory of the Owlbear tribe.
history: The uplands have served as nesting grounds for generations.
Totem circles were erected to honor Owlbear ancestors.
Brood guardians patrol the cliffs to protect hatchlings.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, upland activity intensified.
hooks: A brood guardian calls for aid against invaders.
A nesting cliff destabilizes after a skirmish.
A totem circle emits unusual arcane resonance.
An Owlbear shaman seeks assistance with a ritual.
